evidence_rules.CONFIRMED_CONTROL: requires affirmative independent evidence specifically supporting no activation or impact at the candidate during the frozen event window
evidence_rules.EXCLUDE_ACTIVATED: requires affirmative independent evidence of activation or impact at the candidate during the frozen event window
evidence_rules.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: required when affirmative evidence is insufficient, ambiguous, absent, or documentary silence is the only basis

network_policy: The bundle builder performs no network access. The independent reviewer may use external evidence only after receiving this frozen bundle, and queries must be derived solely from candidate coordinates/candidate code plus the frozen event date.
fail_closed: candidate membership differs from the frozen seven-code packet
selected output fields contain a forbidden token
source template indicates target outcomes, external reference morphometry access, contaminated-stage access or selection feedback
bundle contains a key outside the allowlist
builder imports or invokes network-capable modules
